confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of small Scottish Highland city pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is seasonal and volatile. The FX observation was taken from search-result text attributed to RBA pages and was not checked against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: small Scottish cities and Highland towns such as Stirling, Perth and Fort William, priced below Edinburgh. Accommodation is adjusted upward for the July peak tourist season. Drinks are set by the local beer relationship where direct knowledge is weaker.
